reason: I pay about 1,600đ per dollar of usage through a Telegram reseller. At 26,000đ you're asking me to pay roughly 16 times more for the same models. I'll take the free 50k to try it, but I won't top up.
objection: The price is the full official rate. A VAT invoice and receipts mean nothing to me as a freelancer, and the reseller works fine for my side projects.
would_change_my_mind: If my reseller got shut down or kept giving me fake models, or if I started taking client work that needs a proper VAT invoice.
